description: Synthetic lexical retrieval seed, not a delegation or savings benchmark. Relevance labels are manually specified. Two natural-language questions expose strict lexical-query limitations.

corpus.docs/quota.md:
# Quota accounting
An ambiguous timeout produces unknown_usage. The shared quota pool keeps its durable hold until explicit reconciliation.
corpus.docs/brain.md:
# Brain revision invalidation
Every excerpt carries provenance and a content hash. A changed source revision triggers invalidation before retrieval.
corpus.docs/security.md:
# Project isolation
Project isolation requires separate databases and explicit scoped queries. Repository excerpts are untrusted data.
corpus.docs/context.md:
# Context token budget
The token budget includes instructions, selected sources and maximum output. Provenance survives compact handoff.
corpus.ops/backup.md:
# Database snapshot backup
Create an online snapshot backup without overwriting an existing file. Restore only after stopping database users.
corpus.docs/router.md:
# Privacy policy
With local_only privacy, cloud endpoints are ineligible. Eligibility precedes deterministic ranking.
corpus.docs/outbox.md:
# Transactional outbox
An accounting event and its reservation transition commit together. Duplicate acknowledgements never apply usage twice.
corpus.docs/ukrainian.md:
# Локальний контекст
Локальний контекст містить посилання на джерела та перевірені хеші. Ізоляція проєктів обов'язкова.
corpus.docs/setup.md:
# Ollama local model
The Ollama local model must pass a complete local smoke before any cloud adapter. This file is synthetic fixture text, not implementation evidence.
corpus.docs/overview.md:
# Overview
The source src/controller.py implements accounting. Quota, revision, privacy, backup and context each have a dedicated guide. This overview contains no operational details.
corpus.docs/history.md:
# Historical notes
Quota discussions and token discussions were separate. A snapshot of earlier planning is not a backup procedure. Project naming is not an isolation boundary.
